title: opencode-prompts definition
description: Definition file for the opencode-prompts OpenCode v2 plugin. Maps existing native agent IDs to prompt policies. Mirrors the plugin decoder: unknown fields are rejected, agent IDs and slot names stay free-form, and there is no model-family registry.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint. The plugin only requires a nonempty string.

version.description: Optional format version. When present it must be the number 1.

agents.description: Maps native agent IDs, for example "build", to prompt policies. The plugin never creates agents.

templateSource.description: Inline template text, or a file read relative to the definition directory.

slotSource.description: Inline text, a file read relative to the definition directory, or one raw runtime binding.

runtime.description: Insert raw host data. Strings render as-is; other values render as 2-space JSON.

slots.description: User-named placeholders referenced from the template. Names must be nonempty and must not contain whitespace, braces or colons.

models.description: Anchored, case-sensitive glob patterns matched against the full providerID/modelID ref. * and ? also span /.

excludeModels.description: When any pattern matches the model ref, the whole rule is skipped.

template.description: Default template. It may be omitted when a matching rule supplies one.

allowRepeatedSlots.description: Allow a used slot to appear more than once. Defaults to false. Repeated {{name:omit}} markers are never allowed.

rules.description: All matching rules apply in order; later rules win per field, and slots merge by name.
